title: Validity and reliability of a Thai-translated malnutrition screening tool in an outpatient setting: a comparison with the GLIM criteria
core_idea: Translate the Malnutrition Screening Tool (MST) into Thai and assess its validity and reliability in an outpatient tertiary care setting by comparing the Thai-MST to the GLIM criteria (including bioelectrical impedance analysis for muscle mass) and the MNA-SF, using a cross-sectional sample of 248 participants and metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, ROC-AUC, test-retest and inter-rater reliability, and internal consistency.
tldr: The study translated the MST into Thai and evaluated its performance against GLIM criteria and MNA-SF in 248 outpatients, using multiple validity and reliability metrics.
